name: preempt-rt-sd-dma-direct

change.description: Keep DMA2 streams 3/6 channel 4 but bypass the STM32 DMA FIFO so every SDMMC request initiates a direct single-beat transfer.

constant_contract.kernel: Linux 5.15.211-rt97 ARM NOMMU FDPIC XIP from QSPI
constant_contract.data: VFAT on the same SD card at approximately 1.95 MHz
constant_contract.latency: TIM3 CH1 PB4/D3 hardware reference to priority-99 SCHED_FIFO kthread PG7/D4 response

boot.observation: Direct mode reproduced the full-FIFO result: MMCI found receive data after the DMA completion wait, released DMA, emitted two tasklet-from-interrupt warnings, and did not reach login after the FAT mount began.

storage_probe.reason: DMA was disabled during partition discovery and /data initialization did not complete.

hammer.reason: The SD transport was not safe enough to mount or repair the benchmark FAT volume.

decision: Do not carry direct mode. The verified STM32CubeF7 board implementation uses full-FIFO INC4 transfers with peripheral flow control, while Linux MMCI hard-codes device_fc=false. Add a board-opt-in MMCI peripheral-flow-controller property and return the DMA feature to full-FIFO mode.
interpretation: The repeated receive tail proves that DMA FIFO thresholding is not the cause. The remaining material mismatch with the validated LXP/oveRTOS transport is the DMA PFCTRL bit.
